newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - RANGEBOUND NOTIONNEL TO TEST 129.24 PROP.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - RANGEBOUND NOTIONNEL TO TEST 129.24 PROP.

text.p: September notionnel futures traded on MATIF will remain entrenched within their recent range on Thursday with support expected in the 129.24, 26 region, technical analysts said.
Little activity was expected ahead of the long weekend in France, they said.
"This morning the market is very quiet," said Marc la Croix, broker at STAFF in Paris. "We expect notionnel to move between 129.24, 26 as support and 129.66, 68 for good resistance."
At 0833 GMT, September notionnel futures were at 129.58, up 32 basis points on the day.
La Croix said if anything, after the move during the latter part of Wednesday's session, he expected the notionnel to go back to the 129.24-30 area and find support there.
"We will probably see some buying at these levels this afternoon," he said.
Christian Bado, senior technical analyst at Ferrier Lullin in Geneva, said before testing support, the contract would move higher.
"It looks like a small short-term bottom has formed around 129.00 which suggests buys above 129.50 for a test 130.06," he said.
Bado said there was interim resistance at 129.80.
"Any breakout from there would signify an impulsive wave to 130.05 before coming down again," he said.
He said support in the 129.00, 128.94 region was not likely to be broken.
At the short end, September Pibor futures were at 96.49, up one basis point on the day.
